data.name: Ghaniyat

data.long_meaning: Someone who is constantly thankful and grateful. The name Ghaniyat carries the meaning “Thankful, Grateful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Ghaniyat usually hope their child will grow to embody thankful, grateful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who recognizes and appreciates the blessings in their life
data.etymology: Ghaniyat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Thankful, Grateful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghaniyat total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: غنيات
in_arabic.long_meaning: غنيات من أسماء الله الحسنى، وتُشير إلى الحالة التي يكون فيها الفرد غنيًا بالعافية والرزق، ويُستخدم الأسم غانيات أيضًا في اللغة العربية للإشارة إلى المولى الذي يرزق عباده بحسن ظنه، ويُستعار هذا الأسم أيضًا في اللغة الإنجليزية للإشارة إلى الرفعة والكرامة، كما يُستخدم في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية للإشارة إلى النجاح والتفوق، ويُعد غنيات اسمًا مشتقًا من الجذر غ-ن-ي، والذي يُشير إلى الفعل الغِنى، والذي يعني الحصول على المال والرزق، ويُستخدم هذا الأسم في القرآن الكريم للإشارة إلى الله سبحانه وتعالى، ويُعد غنيات اسمًا رائعًا ومثمرًا في الثقافات الإسلامية، ويمكن استخدامه في الأسماء الشخصية للاعتراف بالحالة العظيمة التي يرزقها الله لعباده.

in_urdu.name: غنيات
in_urdu.long_meaning: غنيات اللہ کا ایک اسمِ حسن ہے، جو عافیت اور رزق سے ہونے کی حالت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام غنی کے الفاظ سے مشتق ہے، جو عافیت اور فلاح کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اس نام کا استعمال اسلامی ثقافتوں میں بھی کیا جاتا ہے، اور یہ نام عافیت اور فلاح کو ظاہر کرنے کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ग़नयात
in_hindi.long_meaning: ग़नयात एक पवित्र नाम है जिसका अर्थ है अवसाद और धन से समृद्ध। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसे हिंदी में भी उपयोग किया जाता है। इस नाम का उपयोग पवित्र कुरान में भी किया गया है।

in_pashto.name: غنيات
in_pashto.meaning: ګڼی بې پښو او په غوره وړو
in_pashto.long_meaning: غنيات يو دلهزه نوم دی چې دښې پېښو او غوره وړو له مخې ګڼي، دغه نوم دغني له څرنګي سره تړاو لري، چې په عربي ژبه کې دښې پېښو او غوره وړو ته ویل کېږي، دغه نوم په پښتو ژبه کې دښې پېښو او غوره وړو ته ویل کېږي.

in_english.name: Ghaniyat
in_english.meaning: Abundance and prosperity, blessed with good health and fortune
in_english.long_meaning: Ghaniyat is a beautiful and meaningful name that signifies abundance and prosperity, blessed with good health and fortune. Derived from the Arabic root word 'Ghani', which means to be abundant and prosperous, this name is a reflection of the divine blessings and favors bestowed upon the believers. In the Quran, Allah is often referred to as 'Ghani', emphasizing His infinite abundance and generosity. This name is a testament to the Islamic tradition of seeking blessings and guidance from Allah, and is a popular choice among Muslims worldwide.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ghaniyat, meaning "constantly thankful and grateful," is a reminder of the importance of gratitude and appreciation in the Islamic culture. Expressing gratitude towards Allah and fellow beings is considered a noble and essential virtue in Islam. The cultural significance of this name comes from the teachings and practices it inspires - to continually acknowledge and thank Allah for His blessings, and to express appreciation to others for their kindness and support. In a broader sense, Ghaniyat can serve as a catalyst for promoting a sense of gratitude in our daily lives and strengthening community bonds through acts of thanks and appreciation.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ghaniyat embodies the distinctive quality of s Abu Hurairah (radiyallahu 'anhu), who was renowned for his extreme enthusiasm for learning hadith and spreading it amongst the people. He was always eager to learn more and grateful for even the smallest blessings. In the Islamic spiritual tradition, haraka, or thankfulness, is considered an essential dimension of tawakkul, or trust in Allah. When we express gratitude, we acknowledge Allah's role in our lives and demonstrate our submission to His will. By continuously living a grateful life, a person named Ghaniyat can nurture a stronger connection with Allah and strive towards greater spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Thankful, Grateful" symbolizes Someone who is constantly thankful and grateful. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ghaniyat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of thankful, grateful.
